desc:
🔫 WELCOME TO BLITZ FPS!

BLITZ is a fast-paced Roblox first-person shooter built for nonstop action, satisfying gunplay, and highlight-worthy moments. Jump into intense multiplayer matches, master powerful weapons, and prove you have the best aim in the lobby!

⚡ FAST-PACED COMBAT
• Free-for-All and Team Deathmatch
• Quick matches, fast respawns, and responsive movement
• Assault rifles, SMGs, shotguns, snipers, pistols, and specialty weapons
• Earn killstreaks, hit headshots, and create insane clips

🏆 UNLOCK & MASTER
• Level up weapons through Weapon Mastery
• Unlock guns, wraps, charms, perks, and crates

👥 PLAY WITH FRIENDS
Squad up, chase high-elimination games, climb the leaderboards, and become a BLITZ legend.

✨ ROBLOX PLUS / PREMIUM
Exclusive banner, badge & occasional crate rewards.

scripts.title: Berpa Hub OP - ERICBERPA
scripts.features:
🎯 PROJECT BERPA — BLITZ FPS EDITION
(You can buy free key for the hub for 3.99$)
[DM ME _mayusrider_]
⚡ ESP, aim assist, and a configurable aimbot in one BLITZ FPS hub.

⚔️ COMBAT FEATURES
- 🎯 Aim Assist: Hold the right mouse button to assist your aim.
- 🤖 Aimbot: Automatically tracks the closest eligible target within your FOV.
- 🛡️ Team Filtering: Excludes teammates from targeting.
- 👁️ Visibility Check: Option to target players without obstacles in the way.
- 🎚️ Adjustable Controls: Choose head or torso targeting and tune aim strength and FOV with sliders.
👁️ VISUAL FEATURES
- 📦 ESP boxes, player names, health bars, and tracers.
- ✨ Target highlights with adjustable opacity.
- ⭕ Visible FOV circle and adjustable ESP distance.
- 🤖 Option to include bots.
🎨 INTERFACE
- 🖱️ Draggable menu.
- ⌨️ Press Right Shift to show or hide the menu.
- ⚙️ Restore recommended settings with one click.
- 🔑 Access through the Project Berpa key system.
